item.title: Over 250 New Affordable Homes Break Ground In Regent Park
item.description: Toronto’s Regent Park is poised to welcome 271 new affordable homes as the next phase of its revitalization moves forward. A new 26-storey tower, at the southeast corner of Gerrard Street East and Dreamers Way, will deliver 136 replacement rent-geared-to-income (RGI) units and 135 new affordable rental homes, with a focus on family-sized apartments. item.title: Tightening Supply Could Support GTA Home Sales Later This Year: TRREB
